g.text: Sources: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2022 (July 1); Statistics Bureau of Japan / e-Stat (October 1).
Same percentage scale; one equally weighted observation per state/DC or prefecture. Medians are not national rates.
Japan rates are officially published to one decimal; U.S. values calculated from resident population counts.
